field.description_en: The JSON path of the event field. Dot-notation nesting is supported
field.description_zh: 事件字段的 JSON 路径，支持点号嵌套
field.title: 字段

value.description_en: The matching value. Separate multiple values with commas when using IN or NOT_IN
value.description_zh: 匹配值，IN/NOT_IN 时逗号分隔多个值
value.title: 值

expression.description_en: Use either expression or relation. If expression is not empty, it takes precedence and relation is ignored. If expression is empty or not specified, relation (AND or OR) is used to perform a simple AND/OR operation on all conditions. Condition numbers correspond to the indexes of the conditions array (starting from 1). Each condition evaluates whether a single event field matches by using field (the event field path, which supports dot-notation nesting such as resource.tags.pod), op (the operator, such as CONTAIN, EQ, or IN), and value (the matching value)
expression.description_zh: expression 和 relation 二选一使用。如果 expression 非空，它优先生效，relation 被忽略；如果 expression 为空或不传，则用 relation（AND 或 OR）对所有条件做简单全量与/或运算。条件编号对应 conditions 数组的下标（从 1 开始），每个条件通过 field（事件字段路径，支持点号嵌套如 resource.tags.pod）、op（操作符，如 CONTAIN、EQ、IN 等）、value（匹配值）来评估单个事件字段是否匹配
expression.title: 表达式

relation.description_en: The logical relationship between conditions. This parameter takes effect when expression is empty
relation.description_zh: 条件间逻辑关系。expression 为空时生效
relation.title: 条件间关系
